Job Description
Purpose of the role
To build and maintain the systems that collect, store, process, and analyse data, such as data pipelines, data warehouses and data lakes to ensure that all data is accurate, accessible, and secure.
Accountabilities
- Build and maintenance of data architectures pipelines that enable the transfer and processing of durable, complete and consistent data.
- Design and implementation of data warehoused and data lakes that manage the appropriate data volumes and velocity and adhere to the required security measures.
- Development of processing and analysis algorithms fit for the intended data complexity and volumes.
- Collaboration with data scientist to build and deploy machine learning models.
Assistant Vice President Expectations
- To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
- Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
- If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
- OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
- Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
- Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
- Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
- Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
- Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
- Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
- Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
- Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
Join us as a Data Engineer at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our data platforms and real-time processing capabilities, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge cloud and streaming technologies to build and manage scalable, resilient, and secure data solutions, enabling seamless delivery of our digital and data-driven services.
To be successful as a Data Engineer you should have experience with:
-
Experience in Databricks with creation of data products, pipelines, scheduling jobs, etc. in AWS.
-
Develop Kafka Streams, Spring Kafka, and Apache Flink applications for real-time event processing
-
Implement parsers for various message formats: ISO 20022 XML, SWIFT MT, JSON, and flat files
-
Build data transformation logic to flatten hierarchical messages into target AVRO schemas
-
Implement stateful transformations including aggregations, joins, and windowed operations
-
Integrate with source systems via IBM MQ and Kafka topics
-
Write clean, testable, and well-documented code following established standards
-
Create and maintain unit tests and integration tests for developed components
-
Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback constructively
-
Troubleshoot issues using ELK stack and application logs
-
Actively participate in Scrum ceremonies and collaborate with team members
-
Strong proficiency and solid understanding of core concepts and modern features with cloud technologies such as Snowflake, AWS, Databricks.
-
Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and Spring Framework
-
Strong unit testing skills using JUnit 5 and Mockito
-
Good understanding of data structures and algorithms
-
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
Some other highly valued skills may include
-
Experience with IBM MQ or JMS-based messaging
-
Knowledge of payment processing domain and creation of Data products in a Data mesh space.
-
Familiarity with ELK stack for logging and troubleshooting
-
Experience with SWIFT parsing libraries (Prowide Core)
-
Experience with Flink stateful processing, checkpointing, and state backends
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
The role is based out of Pune .

Join us as a Data Engineer at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
To be successful as a Senior Software Engineer, you should have experience with:
- Overall experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, process mining, business intelligence, data warehousing, or enterprise data platforms.
- Hands-on experience with Celonis, including Data Integration, Data Pools, Data Models, Transformations, Analyses, and Process Mining use cases.
- Strong SQL expertise, including complex joins, window functions, performance tuning, incremental loading, and data quality validation.
- Strong understanding of Celonis Process Query Language (PQL), process mining concepts, event logs, activity tables, case tables, and KPI modelling.
- Experience building scalable data pipelines into Celonis from enterprise systems using connectors, APIs, databases, or scheduled data extracts.
- Good understanding of banking and financial services processes, including KYC, client onboarding, lending, payments, operations, reconciliation, complaints management, risk controls, and regulatory reporting.
- Experience with relational databases and enterprise or cloud data platforms such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, AWS, and Azure.
- Ability to analyse source system data structures and translate business process logic into reliable Celonis data models.
- Strong troubleshooting skills across data load failures, transformation issues, performance bottlenecks, and data inconsistencies.
- Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including documentation, backlog refinement, sprint execution, and stakeholder demonstration.
Some other highly valued skills may include:
- Celonis certification in Data Engineering, Process Mining, EMS, or related learning tracks.
- Experience with Object-Centric Process Mining and Celonis process intelligence capabilities.
- Exposure to Python, Java, REST APIs, ETL tools, orchestration tools, and automation platforms.
- Experience in enterprise governance, production support, incident management, access management, and release management.
- Knowledge of banking technology controls, data privacy, information security, and audit requirements.
- Experience working with cross-functional teams across business, technology, architecture, compliance, and operations.
- Ability to create reusable data engineering patterns, templates, and accelerators for multiple business processes.
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
The role is based out of Pune.

Technology
Join a small, high-impact engineering team in Citi Markets Technology building the data foundation for greenfield Generative AI products across asset classes. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer who combines deep Python expertise with strong engineering judgement and a practical understanding of how to build reliable, high-performance data platforms.
The role goes beyond constructing ETL pipelines. You will help define how billions of records from diverse Markets data sources are collected, validated, transformed, governed, and made available to production AI applications with consistently low retrieval latency.
If you want to work on ambitious data engineering problems, shape a platform from the ground up, and help define how data is engineered for production AI in Markets, this is the role for you.
The Team
We are a fast-moving team specialising in Generative AI within Markets Technology. We build greenfield products that span multiple asset classes and solve real business problems using modern AI and data engineering approaches.
Our applications depend on a robust and well-designed data foundation. That means creating pipelines and serving layers that can process billions of records while preserving data quality, provenance, security, and operational reliability.
The team is still small enough for every engineer to have genuine influence. Data engineering is a core part of the product architecture, not a downstream support function.
The Role
As a Vice President in the team, you will be a hands-on senior engineer responsible for designing and building the data foundation for greenfield Generative AI products across Markets, including our conversational AI platform.
You will develop production-grade data pipelines and services, primarily using Python, to ingest, validate, transform, enrich, and serve data from a wide range of internal and external sources. You will help create a curated, high-performance data-serving layer that enables low-latency retrieval by our AI and application services.
You will contribute directly to code while also shaping architecture, engineering standards, data models, quality controls, and operational practices. We are looking for someone who can make pragmatic technology choices, challenge assumptions, and take long-term ownership of the platform.
What You’ll Do
- Design, build, and evolve the data architecture supporting Generative AI products across Markets
- Develop scalable Python pipelines that ingest, validate, transform, enrich, and integrate billions of records from diverse sources
- Build curated, queryable datasets and high-performance serving layers for low-latency application access
- Design and optimise the application’s data storage strategies, initially centred on PostgreSQL and Parquet
- Select suitable processing approaches for each workload, from efficient in-process and columnar processing to distributed frameworks where required
- Optimise ingestion, transformation, storage, indexing, and query performance
- Establish robust controls for data quality, reconciliation, lineage, schema evolution, idempotency, and recovery
- Build production observability into data pipelines, including metrics, logging, alerting, and operational diagnostics
- Design solutions that respect data classification, entitlements, access controls, and security requirements
- Contribute directly to code, architecture reviews, technical standards, and the wider engineering direction of the team
- Build automated tests and CI/CD pipelines that enable reliable and repeatable delivery
- Collaborate closely with AI engineers, software engineers, architects, product partners, and Markets stakeholders
- Use AI-assisted engineering tools, including Devin and GitHub Copilot, to improve development quality and productivity
What We’re Looking For
- Extensive hands-on experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a closely related discipline
- Deep practical expertise in Python and the ability to build maintainable, production-grade software
- A proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale data platforms or data-intensive applications
- Strong SQL skills and extensive experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL
- Experience with data modelling, indexing, partitioning, query optimisation, and database performance tuning
- Strong knowledge of the Python data ecosystem, including libraries such as pandas, PyArrow, SQLAlchemy, and NumPy
- Practical experience working with columnar formats such as Apache Parquet and selecting efficient storage and serialisation strategies
- Experience processing large-scale datasets using technologies such as Apache Spark, Dask, Polars, or equivalent frameworks
- Strong understanding of ETL and ELT architecture, including incremental processing, idempotency, failure recovery, and schema evolution
- Experience implementing automated data quality controls, reconciliation, lineage, monitoring, and operational alerting
- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design, testing, maintainability, code review, and CI/CD
- Experience deploying and operating services on container platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift
- Understanding of data governance and security practices, including encryption, masking, classification, entitlements, and fine-grained access control
- The ability to operate in ambiguity, take ownership, and influence the technical direction of a product
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to engineering
What Makes This Role Different
This is not a role focused on maintaining legacy ETL jobs or moving data between systems without understanding how it will be used.
You will help build the data foundation of a new generation of AI products in Markets. The engineering challenges include integrating complex datasets, processing billions of records, delivering consistently low retrieval latency, and meeting the quality, security, and reliability standards expected of production financial systems.
The role offers the opportunity to influence the architecture from an early stage, work closely with AI and application engineers, and take genuine ownership of a platform that is central to the product.
Preferred Experience
- Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect
- Familiarity with Generative AI applications, retrieval architectures, LLMs, agentic systems, or structured evaluation
- Experience building data foundations for search, retrieval, analytics, machine learning, or AI applications
- Knowledge of financial instruments, trading concepts, and data structures within FX, Equities, or other capital markets domains
- Experience working with temporal, reference, market, or transactional data
- A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline, or equivalent professional experience

Job Description
Fixed Income (FI) is the primary source of capital for corporations, governments, and nonprofits, providing liquidity and innovative solutions globally across the credit, municipal, and securitized markets. The Fixed Income Data Platform Team is the foundational pillar of this mission, engineered to provide the low latency, high concurrency, scalability, and unparalleled availability required for our groundbreaking solutions. Our Data Platform Engineering team operates at the forefront of innovation, constantly researching, adapting, and strategically deploying the latest open-source data platforms to meet Citi's unique and evolving needs. We are a collaborative, high-performing group dedicated to solving complex technical challenges and building highly performant, resilient systems.
We are seeking a Vice President, Lead Data Platform Engineer to provide deep technical expertise, hands-on contribution, and direct coaching to our talented engineering team. This role is pivotal in driving the technical design, development, and implementation of Citi's next-generation data platform, with a critical focus on architecting complex streaming solutions, robust data pipeline architectures, and scalable microservices . This platform empowers quantitative scientists and traders to rapidly iterate on and deploy cutting-edge analytical and trading tools. We are looking for a polyglot expert who can directly contribute across diverse technology stacks, guide technical direction, and elevate the skills of junior engineers through direct technical leadership.
Key Responsibilities:
-
Hands-on Technical Leadership & Coaching: Provide technical leadership through direct code contribution, architecture review, and hands-on guidance to junior and mid-level data engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning across polyglot environments.
-
Drive & Implement Architecture & Design: Directly contribute to and drive the technical design and hands-on development of highly scalable, low-latency, fault-tolerant data pipelines, real-time streaming platforms (e.g., Flink), and microservices architectures.
-
Platform Infrastructure & Operations Deep Dive: Actively participate in the strategic planning, setup, enhancement, migration, and operational excellence of critical platform infrastructure, including distributed streaming (Flink) and high-performance caching solutions (Redis).
-
Open Source & Emerging Technologies Evaluation: Continuously research, evaluate, and prototype emerging open-source data and streaming technologies, leading their integration into Citi's data platform through direct implementation. This includes evaluating new streaming frameworks and caching solutions.
-
Performance & Resilience Optimization: Proactively identify and implement architectural and systemic performance optimizations to ensure optimal efficiency, responsiveness, and resilience across the entire data platform, including Flink and Redis clusters.
-
Cross-Functional Technical Collaboration: Collaborate closely with senior technical stakeholders across engineering, data science, and business teams to translate complex technical requirements into robust, high-impact implementations.
-
Delivery & Code Quality Assurance: Drive the timely, high-quality, and secure delivery of data platform features, championing agile methodologies, engineering best practices, and ensuring accountability for code quality and robust testing.
-
Technical Problem Solving: Act as a primary escalation point for complex technical challenges, providing expert diagnosis and hands-on resolution.
-
Operational Flexibility: May occasionally work a non-standard shift including nights and/or weekends and/or have on-call responsibilities to support critical platform operations.
Qualifications:
-
10+ years of demonstrable and highly hands-on experience in software development, with at least 3-5 years in a lead technical contributor or staff engineer role within a data-intensive environment.
-
Deep Architectural & Implementation Expertise: Proven expertise in designing, building, and implementing Microservices and complex streaming/data pipeline architectures.
-
Polyglot Proficiency & Technical Authority: Demonstrated ability to be a technical authority and actively contribute across multiple programming languages/frameworks, with strong hands-on experience in Java (Java 11+ preferred) , and significant expertise in Python , along with practical knowledge of front-end technologies like Angular/React.
-
Expertise in Flink Ecosystem: In-depth architectural understanding and hands-on experience with Apache Flink for real-time stream processing, including Flink SQL, DataStream API, and state management. Comprehensive knowledge of Flink infrastructure setup, maintenance, enhancement, migration strategies, and experience in evaluating/integrating alternative streaming frameworks.
-
Mastery of Redis: In-depth knowledge and practical experience with Redis, encompassing not only data structures, caching patterns, and pub/sub mechanisms but also strategic expertise in Redis cluster setup, maintenance, enhancement, and migration strategies for mission-critical, high-performance applications.
-
Distributed Systems & Data Engineering: Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts and extensive hands-on experience with data distribution platforms like Apache Kafka, and various big data storage/querying systems (e.g., Trino, Pinot, Druid, Ignite) for low-latency access in large-scale, distributed data pipelines.

The future of money is being built right now. At FIS, we help the world’s businesses, banks and communities move, manage and grow money with confidence. Join a team that values fresh thinking, works together to solve complex challenges, and creates technology that powers everyday life.
About the role
As a Data Engineer, AI Governance , you will design, build, and maintain the data foundations that support responsible, trusted, and scalable AI across FIS. This role combines deep backend engineering expertise with a passion for data quality, governance, and transparency. You will serve as a data wrangler and problem solver, ensuring data is discoverable, traceable, reliable, and fit for purpose while providing visibility into data lineage, ownership, and usage throughout the enterprise.
Your key responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend data pipelines, integrations, and data platforms that support AI governance and analytics initiatives.
- Consolidate and transform data from multiple enterprise sources into trusted, governed datasets for AI and business consumption.
- Establish and maintain end-to-end data lineage, enabling visibility into where data originates, how it is transformed, and how it is consumed.
- Partner with business, technology, and governance teams to define data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models.
- Implement data quality controls, monitoring frameworks, and observability practices to proactively identify and resolve data issues.
- Develop metadata management processes that improve data discoverability, traceability, and governance compliance.
- Support data access governance by helping define, automate, and monitor data access controls and permissions.
- Build and maintain data validation, reconciliation, and audit capabilities that improve trust in enterprise data assets.
- Collaborate with AI, machine learning, and analytics teams to ensure governed data is available for model development and operational use cases.
- Recommend and implement automation opportunities that improve data reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence.
What you bring
Required qualifications
- Experience as a Data Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Data Integration Engineer, or similar role supporting large-scale data environments.
- Strong experience building and supporting backend data pipelines using modern data engineering practices.
- Experience with data integration, transformation, cleansing, and consolidation across multiple data sources.
- Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management, and data lifecycle management.
- Experience establishing and documenting data lineage, data flows, and data dependencies.
- Proficiency with SQL and data modeling concepts in enterprise data environments.
- Experience with cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, and data lake architectures.
- Knowledge of data security, access management, and governance principles.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
- Passion for creating high-quality, trusted, and well-governed data products.
Preferred qualifications
- Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or responsible AI governance programs.
- Familiarity with data catalog, metadata management, data lineage, or data observability platforms.
- Experience implementing enterprise data quality and monitoring frameworks.
- Experience within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or highly regulated industries.
The impact you’ll make
As a Data Engineer, AI Governance , you will help establish confidence in the data that powers AI and business decision-making across FIS. Your work will enable clear visibility into data origins, transformations, ownership, and consumption while ensuring high standards of quality, accessibility, and governance. By building trusted data foundations, you will play a critical role in advancing responsible AI adoption and delivering scalable solutions that create long-term value for the organization.
What we offer you
Bring your ideas. Build your future. At FIS, you'll find the support, resources and opportunities to develop your career while helping shape the future of financial technology.
We offer:
- Internal career growth opportunities
- Opportunities to innovate in fintech
- Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
- Professional and personal development
- Resources to contribute to your community
Privacy Statement
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice .
Sourcing Model
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. Data Platform Engineer (Data & DevOps)
At Johnson Controls, you will help build and operate the data platform behind OpenBlue, our smart-building platform. In this role, you will build and run the streaming and lakehouse pipelines that deliver trusted building and energy data to the applications our customers rely on.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer with 3+ years of experience to build, deploy, and operate pipelines on the OpenBlue Data Platform (OBDP). You will work with Kafka, Flink, Spark, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake alongside senior engineers, and own how they run on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) through CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability. This is a hands-on role where you will own well-scoped features and platform operations end to end, from code to production, and take on more design ownership over time.
Key Responsibilities
- Build and maintain Kafka and Flink streaming jobs for ingestion and transformation.
- Develop and maintain Spark jobs for data processing tasks.
- Collaborate with SRE to help manage infrastructure changes.
- Deploy and operate data services and jobs on AKS using Helm and Kubernetes operators.
- Set up monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for pipelines and services (Grafana).
- Support database and lakehouse operations, including Iceberg table maintenance and PostgreSQL backups and tuning.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep).
- Automate environment promotion and deployments across dev, QA, SIT, UAT, and production.
- Support incident response and root cause analysis.
- Write unit and integration tests and fix production defects.
How You Will Do It
- Own the outcome with accountability by delivering reliable pipelines and repeatable operations and following through on commitments.
- Stay close to work by understanding how the data you build is used downstream and how engineers deploy.
- Look for root causes, automate toil, improve continuously, and raise issues with candor.
- Work as one team by partnering with engineers, QA, SRE, and product, sharing context, and asking for help early.
- Use clear documentation, runbooks, and disciplined engineering practices to support consistency and handoffs.
Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in data engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering.
- Hands-on experience with at least two of Kafka, Flink, Spark, Iceberg, or Snowflake, with working knowledge of or eagerness to learn the rest.
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, preferably AKS, including Helm.
- Experience building CI/CD pipelines and using infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep).
- Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.
- Proficiency in .NET, Java, Scala, or Python, solid SQL, and scripting in Bash or similar.
- Understanding of distributed systems basics such as partitioning, fault tolerance, and idempotency.
- Hands-on AI-assisted development and automation with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar, with a critical eye for generated code.
Nice to Have
- Production experience with Kubernetes operators for Flink, Spark, or Kafka.
- Experience with GitOps tools (Flux or Argo CD).
- Azure networking and security basics, including VNets, private endpoints, Key Vault, and Entra ID.
- Exposure to Trino, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or HBase.
- Experience with Apache Airflow.
- Experience with time-series or IoT data.

Overview
Overview
You’ll build the data and pipelines that sit behind TIDE. Your work will help cyber and exposure data move in a clean and reliable way from source to product.
This role is about making data easy to use for others. You’ll work on ingestion, matching, validation, automation and support for the back end of analytics tools that help the business and its clients.
You’ll work closely with the Technical Solutions Manager, the Product App Developer and domain specialists. Together, you’ll make sure the data is clear, well checked and ready for use in reports, apps and other tools.
How You’ll Make an Impact
You’ll build and maintain data pipelines that bring in structured and semi structured data from files, databases and third party APIs. You’ll turn raw data into trusted data by applying clear rules for transformation, matching, validation and enrichment. You’ll also help design data structures and interfaces that work well for downstream analytics and applications.
You’ll look at current ways of working before you automate them. Then you’ll choose the right point to automate, add scheduling and alerts, and build in retry and exception handling. You’ll also measure whether the automation has reduced manual effort, and you’ll say so honestly when it hasn’t.
Your responsibilities will include:
- building reliable ETL and ELT pipelines in Python and SQL
- using pandas or Polars to process and shape data
- working with Snowflake and Dataiku, or similar tools, to support data movement and orchestration
- writing automated tests and data checks that catch problems early
- documenting sources, rules, dependencies and how to run the work
- fixing the root cause when something fails, rather than relying on manual workarounds
- working with the Product App Developer and domain specialists so the data does what the product needs
You’ll also make data lineage, quality checks and failure handling visible to the rest of the team. That helps others understand what the data means, what it can and cannot do, and what it means for a client deliverable.
About You
Here’s what you’ll bring to the role:
- You’ve built production data pipelines in Python and SQL.

Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
Our Impact

Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts .
About the Role:
We are looking for an exceptional Staff Engineer to shape the architecture and evolution of our data infrastructure as we scale.
Our engineering ecosystem operates multiple database technologies, handles large volumes of data and traffic, and supports a growing number of services and engineering teams.
We need a strong individual contributor who has built and scaled distributed data systems, understands database technologies at a fundamental level, and can solve complex infrastructure challenges across multiple engineering teams.
This role goes beyond operating existing databases. You will design systems, build infrastructure capabilities, challenge architectural limitations, and drive technical initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, performance, and infrastructure economics.
What You'll Do:
- Architect for scale: Design and evolve distributed data architectures capable of supporting significant growth in traffic, data volume, and engineering complexity.
- Build infrastructure platforms: Develop reusable infrastructure components, frameworks, and platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to build scalable systems.
- Drive architectural evolution: Identify fundamental limitations in existing systems and lead large-scale initiatives involving data distribution, sharding, replication, migrations, and architectural modernization.
- Shape technical strategy: Influence database technology choices, architectural patterns, and long-term infrastructure direction across the company.
- Improve infrastructure economics: Lead engineering initiatives that materially improve scalability, resource efficiency, and infrastructure costs.
- Engineer for reliability: Design systems that remain available and resilient under high throughput, infrastructure failures, and changing workload patterns.
- Create organizational leverage: Establish engineering standards and reusable solutions that eliminate recurring problems across teams.
- Lead through technical influence: Work with senior engineers and engineering leadership to turn ambiguous, company-level challenges into executable technical programs.
What We're Looking For:
- 9+ years of strong software engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, backend infrastructure, or large-scale data platforms, with demonstrated Staff-level technical impact.
- Strong software engineering background with experience designing and building production infrastructure, not only operating or administering it.
- Experience architecting systems handling multi-terabyte datasets and 30K–50K+ operations per second, or comparable large-scale distributed workloads.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, concurrency, fault tolerance, and data distribution.
- Strong hands-on experience with both relational and NoSQL database architectures, including their design principles, scalability characteristics, and trade-offs.
- Experience leading complex architectural initiatives involving multiple systems and engineering teams.
Ability to identify systemic technical problems and design solutions that improve infrastructure across the organization.
- Strong technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to influence architectural decisions without formal authority.
Tech Experience:
We value engineering depth and architectural understanding over familiarity with a long list of technologies.
Strong experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, combined with experience in one or more distributed database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar systems, is highly relevant.
Experience with distributed SQL, search infrastructure, analytical databases, or other large-scale storage systems is an advantage.
We do not expect expertise in any particular combination of database products. What matters is the ability to understand their internals, evaluate trade-offs, and design scalable infrastructure around them.
What Makes Someone Successful in This Role:
You have previously taken ownership of challenging infrastructure problems where the solution required more than improving an individual service or database.
You have designed or significantly evolved distributed architectures, built infrastructure adopted by multiple teams, led complex technical transformations, or enabled systems to operate at substantially greater scale.
You are equally comfortable discussing database internals, distributed systems trade-offs, and long-term architecture as you are working with engineers to turn those decisions into production systems.
Your impact is measured by the systems you enable, the architectural problems you eliminate, and the engineering capabilities you leave behind.

Do you want to build the data foundation behind how a global logistics leader steers its commercial business? As a Senior Data Engineer in our Commercial Data Products & Reporting team, you will own the pipelines, semantic models and reporting data behind a governed portfolio of global standard reports. This is the “one set of numbers” used by sales leadership, finance business partners and area teams worldwide.
About the Role
You will join a small, integrated team of Product Owners, Reporting Analysts and engineers across Denmark and India. Engineering and reporting are built as one product, not handed over between silos. You will be the technical anchor for the data layer and cover the whole chain:
• Ingestion and transformation in Azure Databricks and ADLS.
• Orchestration in Azure Data Factory.
• Semantic models in Azure Analysis Services (AAS) and Power BI / Fabric, which our dashboards and reports are built on.
We are evolving our semantic layer and using AI assistants and agents in our engineering work. You will help shape both.
Key Responsibilities
Build and own the data layer
• Design, build and run scalable data pipelines in Azure Databricks (SQL/PySpark) on ADLS, orchestrated with Azure Data Factory, integrating multiple ERP and operational source systems.
• Design, maintain and optimize Azure Analysis Services models and Power BI / Fabric semantic models, moving business logic upstream into the data platform where it improves performance and maintainability.
• Work with Product Owners and Reporting Analysts to turn requirements into governed data products, dashboards and reports.
Keep it reliable
• Own the monitoring and refresh of scheduled pipelines and models, including root-cause analysis when something fails.
• Maintain runbooks, documentation and lineage so the landscape can be supported by more than one person.
• Apply Git-based version control, code review and dev-to-prod promotion, and uphold data quality and governance standards.
Make it smarter
• Use AI assistants and agents in everyday engineering work, for example for code, testing and documentation, and help make our data AI-ready.
• Build reusable components and automation that reduce manual effort and scale the reporting landscape.
• Introduce and champion new technologies and practices that improve efficiency, scalability and cost.
Grow the team
• Coach Reporting Analysts and new colleagues on engineering good practice.
• Share knowledge openly, so that no capability depends on a single person.
What We’re Looking For
You don’t need to tick every box. If you match most of the core requirements, we would like to hear from you.
Technical skills
• Backend engineering: hands-on experience with Azure Databricks (SQL/PySpark), ADLS and Azure Data Factory.
• Semantic layer: hands-on experience with Azure Analysis Services and Power BI / Fabric modelling (including DAX).
• Core languages: strong SQL and Python.
• AI: first hands-on experience using AI, such as coding assistants or agents, to support your work, and the curiosity to go further.
• Nice to have: Dremio or similar query layers, MDX, experience migrating from AAS to Power BI semantic models on Databricks, and knowledge of commercial or finance reporting.
How you work
• You explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and push back constructively on scope.
• You turn ambiguous requests into clear requirements and scalable solutions.
• You work well in a globally distributed team, with clear written communication and handovers.
• You take ownership end to end, you mentor others, and you share knowledge generously.
• You are comfortable with Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira.
Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 5+ years of experience in data engineering and/or BI engineering.
What We Offer
• End-to-end ownership of a data stack, with a direct line to the product owners and business users who rely on it.
• Visible impact: data used by Commercial leadership and area teams around the world.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). You have 6+ years of experience building scalable, reliable data platforms and software in agile environments, using distributed systems, microservices and RESTful APIs.

We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer to support Procurement modernization initiatives that enable secure and reliable data exchange across multiple Procurement applications. • 5 to 7 years of relevant technology experience, including at least 5 years of data engineering experience.
• 5 years of hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory.
• 5 years of experience in data engineering and data modeling.
• 5 years of hands-on experience with Terraform.
• 5 years of strong SQL experience.
• 3 years of experience with Azure Functions.
• 2 years of Python experience.
• Experience working with Azure Data Lake, Azure Storage, and Azure SQL.
• Experience designing and supporting scalable ETL and data integration solutions.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Experience with Azure Databricks.
• Working knowledge of React.
• Familiarity with CI/CD and automated deployment practices.

Role purpose
Own the strategy, product roadmap, engineering direction, adoption, reliability and end-to-end service performance of enterprise data and database platforms.
Platform scope
Analytical platforms and services, including Snowflake, Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, together with OLTP and operational database services such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle and Azure Cosmos DB.
Operating model
Lead platform engineering and product ownership while partnering closely with Operations Service Delivery Managers (SDMs) and support teams for stable, secure and efficient day-to-day service delivery.
Leadership profile
A technically credible platform leader who can translate business demand into product capabilities, influence vendors and stakeholders, and grow adoption across the enterprise.
Position Overview
The Cloud Data Platform Product & Engineering Leader is accountable for the full lifecycle of enterprise data and database platform services. The role combines deep technical leadership with product ownership, service management and commercial influence. It covers analytical and AI-enabled platforms as well as operational and transactional database services, ensuring that the portfolio evolves as a coherent enterprise capability rather than a collection of individually managed technologies.
The leader will define the platform vision and multi-year roadmap, prioritize investment, guide engineering standards, drive adoption, and ensure reliable and secure service delivery. The role will work closely with Operations SDMs, platform engineering teams, architecture, security, risk, application teams, data engineering teams and strategic technology vendors to ensure smooth day-to-day operations while progressing modernization, automation and customer-led product outcomes.
This is not a traditional people-manager or operations-only position. It requires a leader who can move comfortably between executive strategy, architecture and engineering decisions, product prioritization, vendor negotiations, operational governance and direct engagement with internal platform consumers.
Scope boundary: This team will provide Cloud Data Infrastructure Platform Engineering as a product. It will build and operate the shared infrastructure, platform services, automation, controls and self-service capabilities that enable data engineering, analytics, data science and AI/ML teams. It will not perform the application-level data engineering or data scientist activities owned by those consuming teams.
Role Mandate
· Own the enterprise product strategy and roadmap for Cloud Data Infrastructure Platform services supporting analytics, AI/ML, data engineering, OLTP and operational database workloads.
· Run the platform portfolio as a set of secure, resilient, scalable, cost-effective and consumable enterprise products.
· Establish clear service boundaries: the team owns Cloud Data Infrastructure Platform Engineering as a product, while consuming teams retain responsibility for data pipeline development, data transformation, analytical model development, data science and business use-case implementation.
· Balance innovation and modernization with operational stability, regulatory obligations and service performance.
· Increase adoption through clear service offerings, reusable patterns, self-service capabilities, simplified onboarding and an improved developer and customer experience.
· Provide the technical depth and leadership needed to challenge design decisions, guide engineering priorities and build credibility with highly technical teams.
· Create an effective partnership between product and engineering ownership and Operations SDMs responsible for service delivery, support coordination and operational governance.
Key Responsibilities
1. Platform Product Strategy & Roadmap
· Own and communicate the vision, product strategy and multi-year roadmap for the enterprise cloud data and database platform portfolio.
· Define the target Cloud Data Infrastructure Platform portfolio across analytical platforms, AI/ML enablement, OLTP databases, NoSQL services, integration foundations and associated platform capabilities.
· Translate business, application, analytics and engineering demand into prioritized product capabilities, investment proposals and measurable outcomes.
· Manage the full product lifecycle, including capability discovery, business case development, prioritization, delivery, adoption, modernization and retirement.
· Build and maintain a transparent roadmap that balances strategic transformation, regulatory commitments, technical debt, resilience, customer demand and cost optimization.
· Establish product principles, service boundaries, service tiers, consumption models and a clear platform service catalog.
2. Broad Data & Database Platform Ownership
· Own enterprise infrastructure platform direction and service outcomes for Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and other cloud data platform services.
· Own platform direction and service outcomes for OLTP and operational database technologies including Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Azure Cosmos DB and relevant managed cloud database services.
· Ensure appropriate patterns exist for relational, NoSQL, distributed, streaming and analytical workloads, with clear guidance on technology selection and fit-for-purpose use.
· Drive interoperability across analytical and transactional platforms so that application data, operational data and analytical data can be governed and consumed effectively.
· Partner with architecture and application teams on modernization, database migration, platform consolidation and cloud-native adoption decisions.
3. Technical Leadership & Platform Engineering
· Provide hands-on technical leadership across cloud architecture, database platform engineering, reliability engineering, infrastructure as code, DevSecOps, shared data integration foundations and platform automation.
· Define and govern reference architectures, engineering standards, reusable patterns, deployment approaches, observability requirements and operational readiness criteria.
· Guide the design of secure, scalable, resilient and cost-efficient platform services across Azure and/or AWS environments.
· Challenge designs constructively, lead technical trade-off decisions and ensure engineering investment addresses reliability, maintainability, performance and customer experience.
· Drive automation, policy as code, self-service provisioning, standardized onboarding, automated controls and self-healing capabilities.
· Sponsor technical debt reduction and platform modernization while maintaining service continuity.
4. Adoption, Customer Experience & Internal Client Partnership
· Drive adoption of Cloud Data Infrastructure Platform products by application engineering, data engineering, analytics, data science, AI/ML and business-aligned technology teams.
· Build a structured engagement model with internal clients to understand demand, pain points, onboarding barriers and future capability needs.
· Simplify the customer journey from discovery and architecture consultation through provisioning, onboarding, production readiness and ongoing support.
· Develop platform documentation, reference architectures, reusable infrastructure patterns, onboarding guidance, training and community engagement that accelerate responsible platform usage.
· Measure adoption, consumption, customer satisfaction, onboarding lead time, developer productivity and realized business value.
· Act as the senior escalation and relationship owner for strategic platform consumers.
5. Operations Partnership & Service Delivery
· Work closely with Operations SDMs to ensure smooth, reliable and predictable day-to-day running of the platform portfolio.
· Define clear accountability and handoffs across product, engineering, operations, managed service providers and vendor support organizations.
· Partner with SDMs on service reviews, incident trends, problem management, change quality, capacity, availability, support demand, service risks and continual improvement.
· Ensure new capabilities and major changes meet operational readiness, supportability, monitoring, documentation, resilience and recovery requirements before production adoption.
· Provide technical and product leadership during major incidents, recurring service issues and high-risk changes, while ensuring long-term corrective actions are prioritized on the roadmap.
· Ensure runbooks, support models, escalation routes, knowledge management and service ownership remain current as the platform evolves.
· Align engineering automation and SRE priorities with recurring operational pain points to reduce manual effort, incident volume, risk and support cost.
6. Reliability, Security, Risk & Governance
· Own platform outcomes for availability, performance, scalability, recoverability, security, compliance and operational resilience.
· Define and govern SLAs, SLOs, service health indicators, capacity thresholds, recovery objectives and key risk measures.
· Ensure backup, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities are designed, documented, tested and improved.
· Partner with cyber security, technology risk, compliance and data governance teams to embed controls into platform architecture and engineering workflows.
· Drive timely remediation of vulnerabilities, audit findings, control gaps, end-of-life technologies and operational risks.
· Ensure regulated and sensitive workloads are supported through appropriate access controls, encryption, segregation, monitoring and evidence.
7. Vendor, Commercial & Ecosystem Influence

· Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor capabilities using clear architectural, operational, commercial, security and adoption criteria.

8. Financial Management & FinOps

Job Description
Data Platform Engineer – Enterprise Common Data Model / Common Data Layer (CDM/CDL)
Pune / Bangalore / Noida, India
Position Summary
As a Senior Data Platform Engineer – Enterprise Common Data Model/Common Data Layer (CDM/CDL) , you will design, develop, and deliver scalable data management solutions that power Rockwell Automation's Enterprise Data Platform. You will report to the Technical Leader – CDM/CDL and work in a hybrid capacity.
You will collaborate with technical leads, analysts, architects, integration teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to build and evolve enterprise data products, canonical data models, and scalable data services that enable trusted, reusable, and governed data across the organization.
Your Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain relational and canonical data models using Azure SQL Database, including tables, views, stored procedures, functions, keys, constraints, and indexes.
- Develop high-quality, performant T-SQL code and optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, dependency analysis, and controlled schema management.
- Design, build, test, and maintain data acquisition, integration, and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Azure PaaS services and DevOps methodologies.
- Architect data structures and pipelines that enable "Data as a Service" capabilities across business units while ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
- Collaborate with integration teams to define data contracts, database interfaces, and enterprise integration patterns.
- Contribute to the evolution of the CDM/CDL platform using technologies such as Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Integration Services.
- Manage CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and deployment automation using Azure DevOps and Git-based workflows.
- Support containerization and cloud deployment practices that enable scalable and resilient platform operations.
- Work closely with analysts, product owners, architects, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high-quality enterprise data solutions.
- Support data governance, data quality, metadata management, and enterprise architecture initiatives.
The Essentials – You Will Have
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
- Strong experience in Azure SQL Database, SQL Server, T-SQL programming, relational database design, and data modeling.
- Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale data integration and transformation solutions.
- Experience across the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
- Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
- Strong understanding of database performance tuning, schema versioning, and platform engineering best practices.
- Make architectural trade-offs and deliver scalable solutions that meet evolving business needs.
The Preferred – You Might Also Have
- 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Software Engineering, or related disciplines.
- Experience with modern Azure data platform technologies including Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Integration Services.
- Experience building enterprise common data models, canonical data models, or master data solutions.
- Experience working with business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
- Familiarity with Data as a Service (DaaS), data governance, data quality, and metadata management practices.
- Experience with containerization and cloud-native deployment architectures.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
- Experience working in a global enterprise environment with cross-functional teams.
- Exposure to enterprise architecture frameworks and large-scale platform modernization initiatives.

Our benefits package includes:

- Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months of employment
- Company volunteer and donation matching programme
- Employee Assistance Program
- Personalised wellbeing programmed through our OnTrack programmed
